name: Home2 Suites by Hilton Las Vegas Stadium District

sources.observed: Official exterior image visually inspected: five floors, white horizontal window bands and perimeter frame, ochre panels/turquoise glazing, gray sign/stair volume with lime edge, stone ground floor. Lobby photo: long upholstered banquette, mixed green/yellow chairs, gold polygonal pendant fixtures, desks with computers, snack shop.
Official exterior shown in hotel page carousel.
Official lobby inspected in full gallery modal; photos linked only.

South court visually inspected: entrance on southeast end, ochre canopy, stone piers, gray sign tower/lime returns and aqua crown; separate garage northeast. January2025 Dean Martin panorama confirms long street facade, tall transom windows, stone end bases and charcoal ground cladding.
Pool terrace along northeast facade by shared north arrival drive; dark vertical fence, stone piers, pergola and red umbrellas. Pool enclosure implemented and reviewed; broader planting remains.

Full official photo inspected: curved pool, blue-tile waterfall wall with flanking planting pots, blue accessibility lift, stainless rails, dark fence/pergola, yellow chairs. TownePlace visible behind confirms north courtyard position.

Breakfast photo inspected: blond wood tables/chairs, lower drawer cabinetry, plate cubbies, microwaves, cereal dispensers and waffle irons. These elements are represented with original simplified geometry; exact dimensions remain inferred.

North courtyard satellite inspected. Pool centre map-picked approximately36.099977,-115.182033, converting to local(11.11,-6.96). Pool is between Home2 and separate garage, south of shared drive. Imagery date not shown; source copyright2026 is not capture date.

Official gallery9 inspected: twin stainless grills in stone counter, yellow chairs and square tables, tall stone piers/dark vertical slat screen, pool gate and planting path beyond. Grill patio now authored; fixtures and dimensions remain approximate.

Official gallery8 inspected: circular firepit table, dark wicker high-backed seating with orange/green striped cushions, planted edge and bollard lamps. Location relative to footprint still requires survey; not built.

South patio shade centre map-picked36.099493,-115.181693 ->local72.14,3.68. Compared with March2020 arrival StreetView and official gallery9 grill/pool-path view. Footprint boundaries estimated, not surveyed.

implemented: Original stepped-footprint five-storey exterior, south entrance canopy and opening, framed transom glazing, end sign volumes, roof services.
Inferred public reception, market, banquette lounge, business desks and breakfast room; cabinetry, appliances and furniture refined against official photographs.
Bounded northeast pool court with curved basin, coping, blue-tile wall, planters, accessibility lift, rails, fence with open gate, pergola and seating; three installed views inspected.

North pool frontage refined from March2020 Street View: broad dark slats, stone end piers/high connecting beam, three folded red canvas umbrellas. Original geometry; dimensions estimated. Three installed daylight views inspected; slats/piers/beam present and gate clear.

Original twin curved-hood grills with handles/control knobs/access doors, stone counter, slatted shade roof/screen, square tables/yellow chairs and a small planted pocket. Two connecting routes added; all three installed daylight views inspected; walking connections verified.
remaining: Seven final installed views inspected: north sign masking corrected; furnishings remain simplified, floor texture visibly streaked, glazing opaque. Further material refinement required.
Planting, arrival landscaping and finer facade/material refinement remain pending.
Glass remains opaque and public layout inferred; guest rooms are not built.
Public rooms remain sparse and stylized; cabinetry/appliance dimensions and branded details are approximate.

Pool wall has no flowing waterfall yet; basin depth, furniture, fence and terrace dimensions remain approximate. Grill patio authored; separate firepit and broader site planting remain to survey and build.

North enclosure broad slats/piers/beam and folded umbrellas authored; planting, finer canvas/chair detail and full patio enclosure still incomplete. Reference dates differ; dimensions remain estimated. Installed gate close-up confirms canvas remains angular.

Grill material no longer receives incorrect diamond plate, but installed alloy reads too matte/dark. Grills, chairs and planting still need finer material/shape work; this is not photorealistic completion.

performance.poolNote: Quiet repeat: overhead16.7median18.6p95,deck18.5median29.3p95,gate16.9median21.4p95ms. Deck is about54fps median and not meeting60fps target; variance remains. Visuals unchanged after subsequent furniture-collision/route correction. No clean pre-pool baseline exists.
performance.diagnosticNote: Initial reversible-ablation run: baseline16.7median18.2p95, restored16.8/17.6ms. Earlier54fps slowdown not reproduced. performance.screenNote: Normal final installed capture: overview16.7/18.9, deck16.6/18.8, gate16.7/19.0ms median/p95. Earlier54fps deck slowdown not reproduced; no attribution or blanket60fps guarantee. No graphics errors in normal final capture log.

Pool repeat16.6/16.7/16.7median17.4/17.3/17.3p95. Grill material classification correction pending final installed review.
performance.patioFinalNote: Final alloy-only correction: patio/grills/path median26.2/22.1/16.7ms, p9540.9/50.7/17.2ms. Same settings as initial patio; substantial variance, no60fps claim. No graphics-error log. Repeat recorded separately.
performance.patioRepeatNote: Repeat median49.7/43.6/19.5ms,p9567.1/58.4/28.2ms (~20/23/51fps). A repository validation scan overlapped part of this run, so it is not an isolated benchmark. Large variance remains unresolved; do not infer a material regression or a60fps pass. A post-run process snapshot showed two unrelated Python jobs at86–94%CPU and another at34%; shared-machine load is a possible confound, not proven cause. Those jobs were left untouched.
